# dead-letter-replayer

> Replay dead-lettered messages safely: filters by topic, error, time and headers, dry runs, rate limits, a replay ledger against double replays and broker-agnostic ports Python package `trysac-dead-letter-replayer`, import name `dead_letter_replayer`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
